terminals.name: vigiepp
terminals.command: VIGIEPP_DATA_DIR="$PWD/backend/data" VIGIEPP_AUTH=1 VIGIEPP_ADMIN_PIN=vigiepp VIGIEPP_OPERATOR_PIN=porteria VIGIEPP_COMBINED_INFERENCE=0 VIGIEPP_DOCS=1 ULTRALYTICS_OFFLINE=false PYTHONPATH="$PWD/backend" .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --app-dir backend

terminals.name: forense
terminals.command: mkdir -p forense/data && VIGIEPP_DATA_DIR="$PWD/backend/data" VIGIEPP_FORENSE_DATA_DIR="$PWD/forense/data" VIGIEPP_FORENSE=1 VIGIEPP_FORENSE_LICENSE=dev VIGIEPP_AUTH=1 VIGIEPP_ADMIN_PIN=vigiepp VIGIEPP_COMBINED_INFERENCE=0 PYTHONPATH="$PWD/backend:$PWD" .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn forense.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001
